environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Node.js 18.x) behind API Gateway REST API with a regional WAFv2 Web ACL association. The Web ACL includes a custom rate-based rule (threshold: 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP with scope-down statement matching header 'x-session-token' presence) evaluated at priority 0, followed by a rule group reference statement pointing to a custom rule group containing a regex pattern set rule that inspects the response body for the literal strings 'Invalid padding' and 'Malformed session data' using a body-based inspection override with oversize handling set to MATCH — however this rule operates on SingleHeader match against x-session-token with a size constraint (>2048 bytes) in COUNT mode only. The primary blocking mechanism is the rate-based rule which aggregates on forwarded IP with a custom key of the x-session-token header value, limiting unique token submissions to 100 per 5-minute window per source IP.
